Success Plan formatting guidance

Keep objective titles short, descriptions operational, and milestones measurable. For plan summaries use Microsite and Resources, About the Dealership Group, Success Plan Goals, Key Hurts and Focus Areas.

Quality control checklist

Objectives tie to outcomes, milestones are measurable, updates avoid duplication, support summaries include expected versus actual, touchpoints include next steps and alignment.

EBR Builder — How to Generate & Run

Choose one path. Macro and VBA is the fastest way to fill the approved EBR template. PowerPoint Copilot is slower, but helpful when you want Copilot to draft slide content for review.

Keyboard version: Use the Windows or Mac Version toggle in the top bar. This guide will display the correct PowerPoint shortcut keys for the selected platform.

How to Generate and Build using Macro and VBA Estimated time 3 to 5 minutes completion
1 Open CDKXGen

Select Executive Business Review, then choose Generate EBR Presentation.

2 Fill in the basics

Enter the dealer name, EBR date, CSM name, ASE name, and AM name.

3 Add your notes

Paste meeting notes or upload the dealer files you want the EBR to use.

4 Click Generate

CDKXGen builds the prompt. Use Push to Copilot only if you need Copilot to create the assignment lines.

5 Paste the Copilot block

If Copilot gives you assignment lines, paste them into Optional Copilot Data Block. If not, leave it blank.

6 Build the macro

Click Assemble & Validate Macro. If it passes, click Copy Raw VBA Macro.

7 Put the macro in PowerPoint

Open the approved EBR template. Press Alt + F11, click Insert, click Module, paste the macro, then close the VBA window.

8 Run it

Press Alt + F8, select FillCDKEBR, click Run, review the deck, then save it.

Validation catches common copy and paste problems before they break PowerPoint.

How to Generate using Copilot within PowerPoint Estimated time 10 to 15 minutes completion
1 Open PowerPoint

Open the approved EBR template before you start Copilot.

2 Add dealer notes in CDKXGen

Paste meeting notes, success plan content, case summaries, transcripts, or other dealer information into Source Notes.

3 Create the Copilot prompt

Click Generate EBR Presentation Prompt for Copilot. CDKXGen copies the prompt for you.

4 Paste into Copilot

Open Copilot in PowerPoint, paste the prompt, and submit it.

5 Review every slide

Check the dealer name, success plan content, recommendations, and next steps. Do not assume Copilot got it perfect. It is helpful, not psychic.

6 Add screenshots manually

Add KPI images, utilization screenshots, PDFs, or DMS Scorecard visuals yourself after Copilot finishes.

7 Save the deck

Save the final EBR using the dealer name and EBR date.

How to Generate Dealer Case Summary
1 Upload the Salesforce file

Go to Upload Documents, click Upload File, and select the Salesforce case export. Use .xls, .xlsx, or .csv.

2 Pick the command

Choose Planning, then choose Generate Dealer Case Summary.

3 Fill in the required fields

Enter the CSM name and select the region. IAM name is optional.

4 Click Generate

CDKXGen reads the file, removes duplicate case numbers, groups cases by status, and creates the case summary.

5 Download the summary

Click Download Dealer Case Summary. Review it, then save or print it as needed.

Shortcuts and onsite CSS request steps

Use Export to AI then paste into your company authorized AI tool. If copy fails, select text and press Ctrl + C.

How to request an onsite CSS

1 Open the dealer account page and start the onsite CSS request process.

2 Select the Activity tab and click Email. Expand the email window if necessary.

3 Click Insert Template and choose All Lightning Templates.

4 Select the Customer Success Specialist Onsite Training Request Form template.

5 Complete all fields including dealer group name, store location if applicable, training objectives, departments involved, number of users, and requested timeline.

6 Review the request and send the email. CSS typically responds within 24 business hours.

7 Save the request and track the follow up activity from the account record.
